about_the_game:
Whether you're working or relaxing,

your Desktop Waifu will always stay on the top layer of your screen, keeping you company.

By idling in the game, you can unlock new outfits—and once unlocked, you can switch to them anytime.

The current version includes 3 outfits, with future updates adding more clothing irregularly, or as DLC releases.

content_descriptors.notes: There's a purple dress that shows some cleavage
